children: Improving earnings and positive post-results price action for some Japanese companies point to a potential inflection, Jefferies quantitative strategists say in a note. Some companies that have underperformed over the past year delivered strong earnings or operating-profit beats and were rewarded by the market during the recent earnings season, the U.S. bank says. These companies include East Japan Railway, Daiichi Sankyo, Fujifilm Holdings, Daiwa House Industry and Sumitomo Realty & Development, Jefferies says. Japan's earnings season for the July-September period remained solid overall, with aggregate earnings up 25% on year, margins near record highs and guidance upgrades broadening despite steady foreign-exchange assumptions, the bank says.
